claimEsgReward(uint256).details: M7: `isOpen` and `openedAt` were both ignored. The struct has      carried them since day one; reading them turns "opened a      qualifying position once" into "is still holding it, and has      been for `minHoldSeconds`". Unchanged by #98.      The registry is read exactly once here (not once for the      eligibility check and again for the badge's reason text) — both      derive from the same `median`/`isRated` pair via CarbonTiers'      pure functions, so there is only one external call to      `esgRegistry` per claim.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

previewReward(uint256).details: The already-claimed check runs first and reads only a mapping —      a position that has already been rewarded (the common      steady-state case for a UI polling every open position) never      pays for the cross-contract `getPosition` call below it.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

rescueERC20(address,uint256).details: The old `withdraw` drained a PEPE pool this contract was      deliberately seeded with. There is no such pool anymore — the      payout is a badge mint, not a transfer — but the contract can      still receive tokens by accident (an old integration still      pointed at this address, a stray transfer). Without any rescue      path at all, those would be stuck permanently with no owner      action able to recover them.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

maxRewardTier().notice: The highest (most carbon-intensive) tier that still         qualifies for a reward. Defaults to `Low` — the platform's         cleanest bucket — matching the old threshold's intent of         "only the best-behaved assets qualify". `Unrated` never         qualifies regardless of this setting — see         `CarbonTiers.qualifiesAtOrBelow`.

minHoldSeconds().notice: Minimum time a position must have been open before its ESG         reward can be claimed.

previewReward(uint256).notice: Whether a position is currently claimable — high carbon tier         (or unrated), already closed, or not yet held long enough         all read as `false`, so this cannot promise a claim         `claimEsgReward` would refuse.

rescueERC20(address,uint256).notice: Recover ERC20 tokens sent to this contract by mistake.
